notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and one life, causing you to loot.
Drake Haven and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Drake Haven trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Drake creature token.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain one life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Drake, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
